query: SELECT sequence.error AS "error!" FROM sequence JOIN world_member ON world_member.world_id = sequence.world_id JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = world_member.id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = player_character.character_id JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id WHERE sequence.id = ? AND sequence.world_id = ? AND sequence.error IS NOT NULL AND world_member.user_id = ? AND world_member.access = 'active' AND player_character.agent_id = ? AND player_character.character_id = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invocation WHERE invocation.sequence_id = sequence.id AND (invocation.agent_id = player_character.agent_id OR invocation.branch_id = "group".branch_id))
